### PT-LNG-01: Health information is written in European Portuguese

**SHOULD** · Level 2 (Forward-compliant) · Users: all · Detection: mixed · Effort: low

**Requirement.** Health information, safety messages and privacy texts for people in Portugal use European Portuguese (pt-PT), not Brazilian Portuguese: "equipa", "registo", "contacto", "telemóvel", and the European forms of address and verbs.

**Why.** People understand health information best in their own variety of the language. Plain language guidance from the Commission and the Publications Office is available in European Portuguese.

**How to improve.** Review texts with a pt-PT speaker; keep a glossary of pt-PT terms; do not ship pt-BR machine translation.

**Sources.** [EC-CLEAR](https://commission.europa.eu/about-european-commission/departments-and-executive-agencies/translation/clear-writing-europe_en), [OP-PLAIN](https://op.europa.eu/en/web/webguide/plain-language-and-easy-to-read), [PT-DL238-86](https://diariodarepublica.pt/)

### PT-SAF-01: The urgent help route names 112 and SNS 24

**MUST** · Level 2 (Forward-compliant) · Users: all · Features: symptom_input, mental_health, ai_generative, emergency_content, chat · Detection: manual · Effort: low

**Requirement.** For people in Portugal, the urgent help route shows 112 for emergencies and SNS 24 (808 24 24 24) for health advice, and works with one tap.

**Why.** These are the national numbers people know; CORE-SAF-01 asks for a route to urgent help.

**How to improve.** Add both numbers to the help screen and to AI and chat safety answers.

**Sources.** [PLD](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dir/2024/2853/oj), [PT-SNS24](https://www.sns24.gov.pt/)

## Sources added by the pack

- **PT-SNS24**: SNS 24, Centro de Contacto do Serviço Nacional de Saúde. National health line, 808 24 24 24, every day, all hours: triage, advice and referral. Also online and in the SNS 24 app Verified: pending. [Link](https://www.sns24.gov.pt/)
- **PT-INFARMED**: INFARMED, I.P., competent authority for medical devices in Portugal. Receives vigilance reports (serious incidents, field safety corrective actions) and notifications of clinical investigations of medical devices Verified: pending. [Link](https://www.infarmed.pt/)
- **PT-CEIC**: CEIC, Comissão de Ética para a Investigação Clínica. National ethics committee for clinical investigation, including clinical investigations of medical devices Verified: pending. [Link](https://www.ceic.pt/)
- **PT-DL238-86**: Decreto-Lei n.º 238/86, de 19 de agosto (uso da língua portuguesa na informação sobre bens e serviços). In force. Information about goods and services offered in Portugal must be given in Portuguese Verified: pending. [Link](https://diariodarepublica.pt/)
